question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Salient
solution: The correct answer is** "Negligible."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Salient** means prominent, noticeable, or important. (सर्वाधिक महत्वपूर्ण या सबसे अधिक दिखाई पड़ने वाला) • **Example**: *The **salient**__ fact about the case is that it involves an American.* • **Negligible** means insignificant or unimportant. (नगण्य, उपेक्षणीय) __ • **Example***: The difference between the two products is **negligible**__.* • Therefore, the antonym of** salient** is **negligible**. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: Noteworthy **means deserving attention or worthy of notice. (रोचक या महत्वपूर्ण, उल्‍लेखनीय; ध्यान देने योग्‍य, विचारणीय) • **Option 2: Striking** means impressive or eye-catching. (बहुत स्‍पष्‍ट; अति प्रभावशाली) • **Option 3: Clear** means easy to understand or transparent. (देखने, सुनने या समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट, साफ़) 37:Tac4, The correct answer is** "proper."**
